Facade marquee/Cinemex sign/poster bank → lobby ticket line with menu/POS boards → concessions counter with POPCORN/DRINKS boards → carpeted ticketed corridor with room numbers, posters, exit signs and person figure all read; kitchen reads weakly (flat gray workline, hood/duct not visible) and the checkpoint capture shows roof + oversized floating labels instead of the checkpoint.

All 14 TC300 labels (01–14) counted across net-eng crops, UC-A/B/C/D and UG67 with two vertical antennas verified at native res; four green trunks with per-TC drops, blue dashed UC→UG67 links, one blue solid UG67→ROUTER/FIREWALL→INTERNET→NIAGARA→PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE chain, no shortcut edge; counts and memberships stable across healthy and all five fault captures.

Same coherent building in both states: architecture opaque with roof, engineering translucent shell with zones, devices, media and labels; no zone disappears.
